Positioning is a census of who holds what. It says nothing about why all of them are holding it at once, and lesson 45 named the quantity that decides how much of a book is really one position: a common factor whose variance rises and falls. That factor has a name and a publication schedule. Lesson 47 takes up the macro cycle, where eleven of the twelve months inside an annual inflation rate were published before the release: on the sixty months it prices, four fifths of a 3.37-point fall is carried by the months leaving the window rather than by the one arriving.
